translations.literal: Second month autumn hunt--metal virtue steadies the norm.
translations.idiomatic: Mid-autumn war-hunt: metal virtue tightens the cord.

sentences.zh: 涼風清且厲，凝露結為霜。

translations.literal: Cool wind pure and keen--congealed dew becomes frost.
translations.idiomatic: Cool winds blow sharp; dew stiffens into frost.

sentences.zh: 白藏司辰，金隼時鷹揚。

translations.literal: White-store governs the season--metal falcon, timely hawk soars.
translations.idiomatic: The white treasury rules the hour; metal kestrels and season hawks wheel.

sentences.zh: 鷹揚猶尚父，順天以殺伐，春秋時序。

translations.literal: Hawks soar like Father Shang--following heaven to strike and kill--spring and autumn keep their seasons.
translations.idiomatic: The hawk lifts like Taigong, killing on heaven's schedule while spring and autumn keep time.

sentences.zh: 雷霆震威曜，進退由鉦鼓。

translations.literal: Thunderclap shakes awesome radiance--advance and withdrawal follow gong and drum.
translations.idiomatic: Thunder rolls his majesty; gongs and drums rule advance and halt.

sentences.zh: 致禽祀祊，羽毛之用充軍府。

translations.literal: Presenting quarry at the side-altar--feathers and fur stock the army stores.
translations.idiomatic: They lay game at the fringe-altar; plumes and pelts fill the armory.

sentences.zh: 赫赫大晉德，芬烈陵三五。

translations.literal: Awesome awesome Great Jin virtue--fragrant blaze outtops three and five.
translations.idiomatic: Mighty Great Jin; fragrance towers past the Three and Five.

sentences.zh: 敷化以文，雖安不廢武。

translations.literal: Spreading transformation through culture--though secure they never scrap arms.
translations.idiomatic: Culture spreads his influence; even in calm they keep the spear.

sentences.zh: 光宅四海，永享天之祜。

translations.literal: Radiance fills the four seas--forever enjoying heaven's blessing.
translations.idiomatic: His light owns the four seas; heaven's favor flows without end.

sentences.zh: 順天道

translations.literal: Obeying Heaven's Way
translations.idiomatic: Obeying Heaven's Way

sentences.zh: 順天道，握神契，三時示，講武事。

translations.literal: Obeying heaven's way--grasping spirit tally--three seasons displayed--discoursing martial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He follows heaven's road, grips the spirit-contract, shows three seasons, and rehearses war.

sentences.zh: 冬大閱，鳴鐲振鼓鐸，旌旗象虹霓。

translations.literal: Winter grand review--jingling bells shake drums and clappers--banners and flags image rainbows.
translations.idiomatic: Winter's great muster rings bells and shakes drums; pennons arc like rainbows.

sentences.zh: 文制其中，武不窮武。

translations.literal: Civil pattern holds the midst--martial without exhausting martial.
translations.idiomatic: Culture reins the core; arms never decay into mere violence.

sentences.zh: 動軍誓眾，禮成而義舉。

translations.literal: He moves the army, swears the host--ritual completes and righteousness rises.
translations.idiomatic: He stirs the camp and binds the troops in oaths until ceremony seals duty.

sentences.zh: 三驅以崇仁，進止不失其序。

translations.literal: Three drives to honor kindness--advance and halt lose no sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Three sides stay open for mercy; columns advance and wheel in order.

sentences.zh: 兵卒練，將如闞武。

translations.literal: Soldiers drilled--generals like keen Tiger Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Troops are honed; commanders rival Tiger Guard heroes.

sentences.zh: 惟闞武，氣陵青雲。

translations.literal: Only such Tiger Guard spirit--breath overtops blue clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Such tiger zeal towers above the cyan clouds.

sentences.zh: 解圍三面，殺不殄群。

translations.literal: Opening three sides of the ring--slaying yet not wiping out whole herds.
translations.idiomatic: They lift three faces of the net, killing yet sparing the herd.

sentences.zh: 偃旌麾，班六軍。

translations.literal: Furling banners--ordering the six armies.
translations.idiomatic: Standards fold; the six hosts rank.

sentences.zh: 獻享蒸，修典文。

translations.literal: Presenting steamed offerings--repairing canonical texts.
translations.idiomatic: They offer winter steam and mend ritual canon.

sentences.zh: 嘉大晉，德配天。

translations.literal: Beautiful Great Jin--virtue paired with heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Blessed Great Jin; virtue equals heaven.

sentences.zh: 祿報功，爵俟賢。

translations.literal: Salary rewards merit--nobility awaits worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Stipends repay deeds; titles wait the worthy.

sentences.zh: 饗燕樂，受茲百祿，壽萬年。

translations.literal: Feasting and banquet music--receiving these hundred blessings--life ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Feasts and music pour forth hundredfold blessings and span endless years.

sentences.zh: 唐堯諮務成，謙謙德其興。

translations.literal: Tang Yao consulted Wucheng--modest modest--virtue thereby rises.
translations.idiomatic: Yao of Tang asked counsel of Wucheng; humble humility lets virtue climb.

sentences.zh: 積漸終光大，履霜致堅冰。

translations.literal: Accumulating gradual advance ends in great brightness--treading frost brings solid ice.
translations.idiomatic: Grain on grain grows glory; tread frost and ice follows.

sentences.zh: 神明道自成，河海猶可凝。

translations.literal: Spirit way completes of itself--even rivers and seas may freeze.
translations.idiomatic: The divine Dao completes itself; rivers can turn to ice.

sentences.zh: 舜禹統百揆，元凱以次升。

translations.literal: Shun and Yu commanded all offices--Yuan and Kai ascended in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Shun and Yu ruled every bureau; Yuan and Kai rose in sequence.

sentences.zh: 禪讓應大曆，睿聖世相承。

translations.literal: Abdition answered great calendar--wise and sacred ages handing on.
translations.idiomatic: Abditions matched heaven's chronology; sage passed sage.

sentences.zh: 我皇陟帝位，平衡正準繩。

translations.literal: Our emperor mounts emperor's throne--balance levels, guideline straight.
translations.idiomatic: Our sovereign mounts the throne; scales hang level and lines stay true.

sentences.zh: 德化飛四表，祥氣見其徵。

translations.literal: Virtuous transformation flies four outer regions--auspicious vapors show their signs.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue flies to the four bounds; lucky mist proves every claim.

sentences.zh: 興王坐俟旦，亡主恬自矜。

translations.literal: Rising kings sat waiting dawn--perishing masters smugly boasted.
translations.idiomatic: Founders watched for dawn; doomed kings slept smug.

sentences.zh: 致遠由近始，覆簣成山陵。

translations.literal: Reaching far begins from near--one basket's toss piles into hills.
translations.idiomatic: Far journeys start near; basket on basket builds a mountain.

sentences.zh: 披圖案先籍，有其證靈液。

translations.literal: Unrolling charts he consults ancient registers--therein lies proof of spirit dew.
translations.idiomatic: He spreads charts and reads old registers; spirit-rain proves them true.

sentences.zh: 玄雲起丘山，祥氣萬里會。

translations.literal: Dark clouds rise from mound and hill--auspicious vapors meet ten thousand leagues.
translations.idiomatic: Dark clouds climb from hills; lucky breath meets across ten thousand leagues.

sentences.zh: 龍飛何蜿蜿，鳳翔何翽翽。

translations.literal: Dragon flies how winding-winding--phoenix soars how glitter-glitter.
translations.idiomatic: Dragons coil upward; phoenix wings gleam.

sentences.zh: 昔在唐虞朝，時見青雲際。

translations.literal: In ages past at Tang and Yao court--sometimes seen amid cyan clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Once at Yao's Tang court phoenix broke through cyan clouds.

sentences.zh: 今親游萬國，流興溢天外。

translations.literal: Now personally wandering myriad lands--floating fragrance spills beyond heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Now he tours every realm; bliss overflows past sky's edge.

sentences.zh: 鶴鳴在後園，清音隨風邁。

translations.literal: Cranes cry in rear gardens--pure tones ride wind's march.
translations.idiomatic: Cranes call in back gardens; clear notes ride the gale.

sentences.zh: 成湯隆顯命，伊摯來如飛。

translations.literal: Cheng Tang lifted bright mandate--Yi Yin came swift as flight.
translations.idiomatic: Tang of Shang rose on bright charge; Yi Yin flew to him.

sentences.zh: 周文獵渭濱，遂載呂望歸。

translations.literal: King Wen hunted beside Wei's banks--thereupon carried Lü Wang home.
translations.idiomatic: King Wen hunted on Wei's shore and drove Lü Wang home.

sentences.zh: 符合如影響，先天天不違。

translations.literal: Tally matches like shadow and echo--before heaven heaven does not rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Sign matches echo and shadow; acting before heaven, heaven never fights back.

sentences.zh: 輟耕綜地綱，解褐衿天維。

translations.literal: Leaving plow he gathers earth's net--doffing coarse cloak he wears heaven's warp.
translations.idiomatic: He drops the hoe to weave earth's net; sheds hemp to knot heaven's rope.

sentences.zh: 元功配二王，芬馨世所稀。

translations.literal: Prime merit paired with two kings--fragrance rare in the age.
translations.idiomatic: Founding merit rivals the two kings; perfume scarce in any era.

sentences.zh: 我皇敘群才，洪烈何巍巍。

translations.literal: Our emperor arrays throng of talents--vast merit how towering-high.
translations.idiomatic: Our sovereign ranks every gift; his deed towers vast.

sentences.zh: 桓桓征四表，濟濟理萬機。

translations.literal: Mighty he campaigns four outer regions--crowded hosts order myriad pivots.
translations.idiomatic: He shakes four frontiers; dense aides thread ten thousand hinges.

sentences.zh: 神化感無方，髦才盈帝畿。

translations.literal: Spirit transformation touches without fixed direction--fine talents fill imperial precinct.
translations.idiomatic: Divine influence finds no fixed spot; genius floods the capital.

sentences.zh: 丕顯惟昧旦，日新孔所諮。

translations.literal: Grand display indeed awaits predawn--daily renewal is what Confucius praised.
translations.idiomatic: Splendor waits before dawn; Confucius prized daily renewal.

sentences.zh: 茂哉明聖德，日月同光輝。

translations.literal: Luxuriant indeed bright sacred virtue--sun and moon share radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Lush indeed his sacred kindness; sun and moon twin their light.

sentences.zh: 伯益佐舜禹，職掌山與川。

translations.literal: Boy Yi aided Shun and Yu--office grasping mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Boy Yi helped Shun and Yu and ruled hill and stream.

sentences.zh: 德侔十六相，思心入無間。

translations.literal: Virtue equals sixteen ministers--thought entering without gap.
translations.idiomatic: His virtue matches the sixteen aides; thought slips through no crack.

sentences.zh: 智理周萬物，下知眾鳥言。

translations.literal: Wisdom orders myriad things--below knows speech of birds.
translations.idiomatic: Knowledge orders creation and discerns every bird call.

sentences.zh: 黃雀應清化，翔習何翩翩。

translations.literal: Yellow sparrows respond to pure transformation--soaring practicing how flutter-flutter.
translations.idiomatic: Golden sparrows answer clearing virtue and wheel in fluttering drill.

sentences.zh: 和鳴棲庭樹，徘徊雲日間。

translations.literal: Harmonious cries perch in courtyard trees--hovering between cloud and sun.
translations.idiomatic: Their blended song rests in yard trees, drifting between sun and cloud.

sentences.zh: 夏桀為無道，密網施山河。

translations.literal: Xia Jie practiced lawlessness--dense nets stretched hills and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Tyrant Jie renounced the Way and cast nets across hill and stream.

sentences.zh: 酷祝振纖網，當柰黃雀何。

translations.literal: Harsh priest shakes slender mesh--what then could yellow sparrows do?
translations.idiomatic: The cruel priest tugged fine mesh; what chance had yellow sparrows then?

sentences.zh: 殷湯崇天德，去其三面羅。

translations.literal: Tang of Yin reverenced heaven's virtue--removed three sides of its net.
translations.idiomatic: Tang of Yin honored heaven's kindness and lifted three walls of the snare.

sentences.zh: 逍遙群飛來，鳴聲乃復和。

translations.literal: Carefree flocks flew in--cries returned to harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Birds fluttered in carefree; voices chimed together.

sentences.zh: 硃雀作南宿，鳳皇統羽群。

translations.literal: Vermilion Bird lodges in south--phoenix commands feathered hosts.
translations.idiomatic: The Vermilion Bird mans the southern lodge; phoenix leads winged hosts.

sentences.zh: 赤烏銜書至，天命瑞周文。

translations.literal: Red crow bore writing down--Heaven's mandate blessed Zhou Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Crimson crows carried script; heaven blessed King Wen of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 神雀今來遊，為我受命君。

translations.literal: Spirit finches wander here now--for our lord who received the charge.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit finches roam today for our ruler who took heaven's charge.

sentences.zh: 嘉祥致天和，膏澤隆青雲。

translations.literal: Auspicious omens bring heaven's harmony--sweet dew lifts upon cyan clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Good omens marry heaven with kindness; fat dew climbs on cyan clouds.

sentences.zh: 蘭風發芳氣，蓋世同其芬。

translations.literal: Orchid breeze sends fragrance--through the age it shares that scent.
translations.idiomatic: Orchid winds bear perfume; the age breathes the same sweet air.

sentences.zh: 釣竿何冉冉，甘餌芳且鮮。

translations.literal: How slowly trails the fishing rod--sweet bait fragrant and fresh.
translations.idiomatic: The rod drifts patient; dainty bait smells sweet and bright.

sentences.zh: 臨川運思心，微綸沈九泉。

translations.literal: Facing the stream he turns his thought--slender line sinks to nine springs.
translations.idiomatic: He ponders by the stream; thin silk sinks to the nine wells.

sentences.zh: 太公寶此術，乃在《靈秘》篇。

translations.literal: Grand Duke treasured this art--it lies within the chapter 《Spirit Secret》.
translations.idiomatic: Taigong prized this craft; it rests in the 《Spirit Secret》 scroll.

sentences.zh: 機變隨物移，精妙貫未然。

translations.literal: Mechanism shifts following things--subtle wonder pierces what is not yet so.
translations.idiomatic: Skill shifts with each catch; fine craft foresees what has not happened.

sentences.zh: 游魚驚著釣，潛龍飛戾天。

translations.literal: Roaming fish start at being hooked--hidden dragon flies to cleave heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Surface trout shy at the hook; submerged dragons leap toward heaven.

sentences.zh: 戾天安所至？

translations.literal: Cleaving heaven--where does it reach?
translations.idiomatic: Storming heaven, where may it arrive?

sentences.zh: 撫翼翔太清。

translations.literal: Stroking wings he soars Grand Clarity.
translations.idiomatic: He folds wings and climbs Grand Clarity.

sentences.zh: 太清一何異，兩儀出渾成。

translations.literal: How strange Grand Clarity--two powers emerge from chaos-formed.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Clarity shifts shape; yin and yang rise from primordial blur.

sentences.zh: 玉衡正三辰，造化賦群形。

translations.literal: Jade armillary corrects three luminaries--creating transformation assigns throng of forms.
translations.idiomatic: The jade sight-line fixes sun, moon, and stars; creation grants every shape.

sentences.zh: 退願輔聖君，與神合其靈。

translations.literal: Drawing back he vows to aid holy lord--joining spirits he merges their numina.
translations.idiomatic: He vows to serve the sage king and mingle souls with every god.

sentences.zh: 我君弘遠略，天人不足並。

translations.literal: Our lord enlarges far-reaching strategy--heaven and man cannot equal him combined.
translations.idiomatic: Our sovereign plots afar; heaven and earth together fall short.

sentences.zh: 天人初並時，昧昧何芒芒。

translations.literal: When heaven and man first paired--dim dim how vast-vast.
translations.idiomatic: When sky and soil first met, all was dim vast shadow.

sentences.zh: 日月有徵兆，文象興二皇。

translations.literal: Sun and moon had portents--patterned emblems raised two sovereigns.
translations.idiomatic: Sun and moon showed signs; figured omens lifted two emperors.

sentences.zh: 蚩尤亂生靈，黃帝用兵征萬方。

translations.literal: Chiyou threw living beings into chaos--Yellow Emperor used arms to conquer myriad directions.
translations.idiomatic: Chiyou scourged the folk; Yellow Emperor marched to every zone.

sentences.zh: 逮夏禹而德衰，三代不及虞與唐。

translations.literal: Down to Xia Yu virtue waned--three dynasties failed to match Yu and Tang.
translations.idiomatic: By Yu of Xia virtue ebbed; three ages never matched Tang and Yu.

sentences.zh: 我皇盛德配堯舜，受禪即阼享天祥。

translations.literal: Our emperor's flourishing virtue pairs Yao and Shun--receiving abdication he mounts the stair and tastes heaven's auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Our sage equals Yao-Shun; taking abdication he mounts the stair and tastes heaven's grace.

sentences.zh: 率土蒙祐，靡不肅，庶事康。

translations.literal: Within earth's span all receive blessing--none fail reverent; myriad matters prosper.
translations.idiomatic: Soil and sky gain blessing; awe reigns; every task thrives.

sentences.zh: 庶事康，穆穆明明。

translations.literal: Myriad matters prosper--solemn solemn, bright bright.
translations.idiomatic: Every duty rests easy, august and bright.

sentences.zh: 荷百祿，保無極，永太平。

translations.literal: Shouldering hundred blessings--guarding boundlessness--everlasting great peace.
translations.idiomatic: He bears hundred gifts, guards the endless span, keeps eternal calm.

sentences.zh: 鼙舞，未詳所起，然漢代已施于燕享矣。

translations.literal: The pi-drum dance--its origin is not detailed; yet already under Han it was performed at feasts.
translations.idiomatic: Drum dance: origins unclear, yet Han banquets already featured it.

sentences.zh: 傅毅、張衡所賦，皆其事也。

translations.literal: What Fu Yi and Zhang Heng rhapsodized were precisely these matters.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yi and Zhang Heng's odes describe exactly these shows.

sentences.zh: 舊曲有五篇，一、《關東有賢女》，二、《章和二年中》，三、《樂久長》，四、《四方皇》，五、《殿前生桂樹》，其辭並亡。

translations.literal: Old melodies had five pieces: first 《East of the Pass Has a Worthy Maiden》, second 《Within the Second Year of Zhanghe》, third 《Joy Lasts Long》, fourth 《The Four Quarters August》, fifth 《Before the Hall a Cassia Tree》--their lyrics are all lost.
translations.idiomatic: Five ancient titles survived from 《The Maid East of the Pass》 through 《Cassia Before the Hall》, yet every lyric was gone.

sentences.zh: 曹植《鼙舞詩序》云：「故漢靈帝西園鼓吹有李堅者，能鼙舞，遭世荒亂，堅播越關西，隨將軍段煨。

translations.literal: Cao Zhi's 《Preface to the Pi-Dance Poems》 states: "Formerly among the Western Garden wind-and-drum musicians of Han Lingdi was Li Jian, who could perform the pi dance; encountering age's wasteland chaos, Jian drifted west of the passes with General Duan Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Zhi wrote in his drum-dance preface that Han Lingdi's western park musicians included Li Jian, master of the drum dance; when chaos scattered the realm, Li fled west with General Duan Wei.

sentences.zh: 先帝聞其舊伎，下書召堅。

translations.literal: The former emperor heard of his old skill and issued edict summoning Jian.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor heard his reputation and summoned Li Jian by edict.

sentences.zh: 堅年逾七十，中間廢而不為，又古曲甚多謬誤，異代之文，未必相襲，故依前曲作新歌五篇。

translations.literal: Jian was past seventy; midway he had ceased performing and did not resume; moreover ancient melodies contained many errors--writings of different ages need not blindly copy--therefore following the old tunes he fashioned five new lyrics.
translations.idiomatic: Past seventy, Li had long quit performing; ancient scores were corrupt, so slavish copying made no sense, and Cao Zhi composed five fresh songs on the old beats.

sentences.zh: 」及泰始中，又制其辭焉。

translations.literal: " By Taishi times its lyrics were again regulated.
translations.idiomatic: During Taishi the court rewrote their words anew.

sentences.zh: 其舞故常二八，桓玄將僭位，尚書殿中郎袁明子啟增滿八佾。

translations.literal: The dance formation remained the usual sixteen performers; when Huan Xuan was about to usurp, Palace Writer Yuan Mingzi petitioned to enlarge it to fill eight rows of eight.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen dancers stayed standard until Huan Xuan neared usurpation and Yuan Mingzi asked to swell the corps to full eight-by-eight.

sentences.zh: 泰始中歌辭今列之後雲。

translations.literal: The Taishi-era song texts are listed below.
translations.idiomatic: Taishi lyrics follow.

sentences.zh: 鼙舞歌詩五篇

translations.literal: Five Pi-Dance Song Poems
translations.idiomatic: Five Pi-Dance Song Poems

sentences.zh: 洪業篇當魏曲《明明魏皇帝》，古曲《關東有賢女》。

translations.literal: The Hong Ye piece matches Wei tune 《Bright Bright Wei Emperor》, ancient tune 《East of the Pass Has a Worthy Maiden》.
translations.idiomatic: 《Grand Venture》 replaces Wei’s 《Radiant Wei Emperor》 and the lost 《Maid East of the Pass》.

sentences.zh: 宣文創洪業，盛德在泰始。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen founded great venture--flourishing virtue rests in Taishi.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen launched the great enterprise; prime virtue settled in Taishi.

sentences.zh: 聖皇應靈符，受命君四海。

translations.literal: Sacred sovereign answered spirit tally--received mandate to rule four seas.
translations.idiomatic: The holy sovereign met heaven's token and took charge of the seas.

sentences.zh: 萬國何所樂？

translations.literal: What do myriad lands rejoice in?
translations.idiomatic: What makes every kingdom glad?

sentences.zh: 上有明天子。

translations.literal: Above there is bright Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Because a luminous Son of Heaven reigns on high.

sentences.zh: 唐堯禪帝位，虞舜惟恭己。

translations.literal: Tang Yao abdicated throne--Yu Shun simply "was respectful in himself."
translations.idiomatic: Yao of Tang yielded the throne; Shun merely perfected himself.

sentences.zh: 恭己正南面，道化與時移。

translations.literal: Respectful in himself, correcting south-facing seat--Way's transformation shifts with seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Self-cultivation faced south; the Dao shifted customs with time.

sentences.zh: 大赦蕩萌漸，文教被黃支。

translations.literal: Great amnesty washes sprouting ills--civil teaching drapes even Yellow Branch.
translations.idiomatic: Amnesty rinses fresh faults; culture drapes lands as far as Yellow Branch.

sentences.zh: 象天則地，體無為。

translations.literal: Model heaven, pattern earth--embody non-action.
translations.idiomatic: He mirrors sky and soil; his substance is non-doing.

sentences.zh: 聰明配日月，神聖參兩儀。

translations.literal: Clever intelligence pairs sun and moon--spirit sagely joins two powers.
translations.idiomatic: His wit rivals sun and moon; sacred might joins yin and yang.

sentences.zh: 雖有三凶類，靜言無所施。

translations.literal: Though there exist three vicious sorts--with calm speech nothing avails them.
translations.idiomatic: Though evil trio linger, calm decree leaves them no leverage.

sentences.zh: 象天則地，體無為。

translations.literal: Model heaven, pattern earth; embody non-action.
translations.idiomatic: Patterned on heaven, modeled on earth, his bodying forth is effortless non-action.

sentences.zh: 稷契並佐命，伊呂升王臣。

translations.literal: Ji and Qi together aided the charge--Yi and Lü ascended as royal ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Ji and Qi aided heaven's charge; Yi Yin and Lü Wang rose as ministers.

sentences.zh: 蘭芷登朝肆，下無失宿人。

translations.literal: Orchid and iris mount morning market--below none lose night's lodging.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet orchids fill the court market; no worthy sleeps unseen.

sentences.zh: 聲發響自應，表立景來附。

translations.literal: Sound issues, echo answers--marker stands, shining glory cleaves.
translations.idiomatic: Make a sound and echoes answer; raise the standard and brilliance follows.

sentences.zh: 哮闞順羈制，潛龍升天路。

translations.literal: Tiger guards obey bridle rule--hidden dragon mounts heaven's road.
translations.idiomatic: Tiger guards heed reins and bit; hidden dragons climb heaven's lane.

sentences.zh: 備物立成器，變通極其數。

translations.literal: Prepare things, establish accomplished vessels--change and penetration exhaust their reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: He sets vessels and completes tools; change and reach probe every number.

sentences.zh: 百事以時敘，萬機有常度。

translations.literal: Hundred affairs keep seasonal sequence--myriad pivots hold constant measure.
translations.idiomatic: Every task follows season; each hinge keeps steady gauge.

sentences.zh: 訓之以克讓，納之以忠恕。

translations.literal: He trains them in yielding victory--receives them with loyalty and forgiveness.
translations.idiomatic: He teaches conquering modesty and welcomes them with loyalty and forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 群下仰清風，海外同歡慕。

translations.literal: Hosts below gaze up at pure breeze--beyond seas alike rejoice in longing.
translations.idiomatic: Courtiers breathe his cool wind; overseas thirst for him too.

sentences.zh: 象天則地，化雲布。

translations.literal: Model heaven, pattern earth--transforming clouds spread.
translations.idiomatic: He mirrors sky and soil; clouds of reform roll wide.

sentences.zh: 昔日貴雕飾，今尚儉與素。

translations.literal: Former days prized carving ornament--now esteem thrift and plainness.
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday prized ornament; today honors thrift and plain cloth.

sentences.zh: 昔日多纖介，今去情與故。

translations.literal: Former days much fuss and fiber--now departure from mere sentiment and old habit.
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday sniffed at trifles; today sheds stale feeling and habit.

sentences.zh: 象天則地，化雲布。

translations.literal: Model heaven, pattern earth--transforming clouds spread.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven modeled, earth patterned--clouds of reform billow outward.

sentences.zh: 濟濟大朝士，夙夜綜萬機。

translations.literal: Crowded the great court gentlemen--from dawn to dusk threading myriad pivots.
translations.idiomatic: Great ministers crowd the hall, threading ten thousand hinges night and day.

sentences.zh: 萬機無廢理，明明降訓諮。

translations.literal: Myriad pivots lack neglected principle--bright bright heaven sends down counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Every hinge stays tended; brilliant heaven drops counsel.

sentences.zh: 臣譬列星景，君配朝日輝。

translations.literal: Ministers likened to ranked star-gleams--lord paired with morning sun's blaze.
translations.idiomatic: Courtiers mirror star fires; the sovereign pairs with sunrise.

sentences.zh: 事業並通濟，功烈何巍巍。

translations.literal: Affairs together cross and aid--merit blaze how towering-high.
translations.idiomatic: Tasks intersect and succeed; glory towers vast.

sentences.zh: 五帝繼三皇，三皇世所歸。

translations.literal: Five emperors continued three sovereigns--three sovereigns ages homeward turned.
translations.idiomatic: Five emperors followed three kings; three kings were ages men admired.

sentences.zh: 聖德應期運，天天地不能違。

translations.literal: Sacred virtue answers timely fortune--aligned with heaven--even heaven and earth cannot oppose.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred virtue meets its hour; heaven aligns so sky and soil dare not resist.

sentences.zh: 仰之彌已高，猶天不可階。

translations.literal: Gazing higher grows yet higher--like heaven without stair to climb.
translations.idiomatic: Look up and he grows higher; like heaven he offers no stair.

sentences.zh: 將復禦龍氏，鳳皇在庭棲。

translations.literal: Soon again will Yu Longshi drive--phoenix roosts in courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Longshi will return to haul chariots; phoenix nests in the yard.

sentences.zh: 天命篇當魏曲《太和有聖帝》，古曲《章和二年中》。

translations.literal: The Mandate of Heaven piece matches Wei tune 《Grand Harmony Has Sacred Emperor》, ancient tune 《Within the Second Year of Zhanghe》.
translations.idiomatic: 《Heaven's Charge》 replaces Wei’s 《Taihe Holds the Sacred Throne》 and the lost 《Second Year of Zhanghe》.

sentences.zh: 聖祖受天命，應期輔魏皇。

translations.literal: Sacred forebear received heaven's mandate--answered season aiding Wei emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The sacred ancestor took heaven's charge and aided Wei in season.

sentences.zh: 入則綜萬機，出則征四方。

translations.literal: Within he threaded myriad pivots--without he campaigned four directions.
translations.idiomatic: Within court he ran every hinge; beyond he struck four fronts.

sentences.zh: 朝廷無遺理，方表甯且康。

translations.literal: Court none neglected principle--frontiers quiet and also peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Palace missed no duty; marches stayed calm yet secure.

sentences.zh: 道隆舜臣堯，積德逾太王。

translations.literal: Way lofty Shun ministering Yao--stored virtue surpasses Grand King.
translations.idiomatic: His Dao rivaled Shun serving Yao; stacked virtue overtopped Grand King.

sentences.zh: 孟度阻窮險，造亂天一隅。

translations.literal: Meng Da barred perilous narrows--creating chaos in heaven's corner.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Da blocked deadly narrows and stirred trouble in one canton.

sentences.zh: 神兵出不意，奉命致天誅。

translations.literal: Spirit hosts emerged unforeseen--received charge to inflict heaven's punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit-like armies struck unseen, bearing heaven's sentence.

sentences.zh: 赦善罰有罪，元惡宗為虛。

translations.literal: Amnesty good, punish guilt--chief villain clan reduced to void.
translations.idiomatic: Mercy for the good, stripes for crime; arch rebel houses emptied.

sentences.zh: 威風震勁蜀，武烈懾強吳。

translations.literal: Awesome wind shakes stalwart Shu--martial majesty cowers mighty Wu.
translations.idiomatic: His gale rattles stubborn Shu; martial awe freezes fierce Wu.

sentences.zh: 諸葛不知命，肆逆亂天常。

translations.literal: Zhuge failed to read fate--recklessly rebelled against heaven's constant.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuge Liang misread destiny and wildly betrayed heaven's norm.

sentences.zh: 擁徒十餘萬，數來寇邊疆。

translations.literal: Hugging troops over hundred thousand--several times came raiding borders.
translations.idiomatic: He hugged hosts beyond a hundred thousand and raided the frontier again and again.

sentences.zh: 我皇邁神武，執鉞鎮雍涼。

translations.literal: Our emperor surpassed divine martialness--grasping axe he guarded Yong and Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Our sovereign topped divine arms; gripping the axe he held Yong and Liang.

sentences.zh: 亮乃畏天威，未戰先僕僵。

translations.literal: Liang then feared heaven's majesty--before battle first collapsed stiff.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuge Liang then dreaded heaven's wrath and fell stiff ere blades crossed.

sentences.zh: 盈虛自然運，時變故多艱。

translations.literal: Full and empty naturally cycle--seasons shift thus many hardships.
translations.idiomatic: Wax and wane turn by nature; ages shift through bitter trials.

sentences.zh: 東征陵海表，萬里克朝鮮。

translations.literal: Eastward expedition mounts beyond sea--ten thousand leagues humbled Korea.
translations.idiomatic: Eastward hosts crossed the sea; myriad leagues brought Korea to court.

sentences.zh: 受遺齊七政，曹爽又滔天。

translations.literal: Receiving testament harmonizing seven regulators--Cao Shuang again flooded heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Entrusted to align the seven powers, Cao Shuang once more drowned heaven.

sentences.zh: 群凶受誅殛，百祿咸來臻。

translations.literal: Crowd of villains suffered execution--hundred blessings together arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel packs died at stroke; hundred blessings gathered.

sentences.zh: 黃華應福始，王淩為禍先。

translations.literal: Yellow splendor answered fortune's start--Wang Ling became disaster's herald.
translations.idiomatic: Golden glory answered bliss's dawn; Wang Ling opened ruin's trail.

sentences.zh: 景皇篇當魏曲《魏曆長》，古曲《樂久長》。

translations.literal: The Scenic Emperor piece matches Wei tune 《Wei Calendar Long》, ancient tune 《Joy Lasts Long》.
translations.idiomatic: 《Radiant Emperor》 replaces Wei’s 《Long Wei Calendar》 and 《Joy Lasts Long》.

sentences.zh: 景皇帝，聰明命世生，盛德參天地。

translations.literal: Emperor Jing, wise--clever life-era born--flourishing virtue joins heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing, wise commander born to his age; virtue spans sky and soil.

sentences.zh: 帝王道大，創基既已難，繼世亦未易。

translations.literal: Way of emperor-kings is vast--founding foundation already hard--continuing age also not easy.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Dao runs vast; founding was hard, succession harder still.

sentences.zh: 外則夏侯玄，內則張與李，三凶構逆，亂帝紀。

translations.literal: Without Xiahou Xuan, within Zhang and Li--three villains plotted rebellion--throwing imperial age into chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Outside Xiahou Xuan, inside Zhang and Li: three traitors twisted the royal calendar.

sentences.zh: 順天行誅，窮其奸宄。

translations.literal: Following heaven executed punishments--exhausted their treasonous plots.
translations.idiomatic: He followed heaven to punish them and rooted every plot.

sentences.zh: 邊將禦其漸，潛謀不得起。

translations.literal: Frontier generals fenced their earliest moves--secret schemes could not arise.
translations.idiomatic: Border generals caught omens early; secret plots never surfaced.

sentences.zh: 罪人咸伏辜，威風振萬里。

translations.literal: Criminals all suffered fitting guilt--awesome wind shook ten thousand leagues.
translations.idiomatic: Guilty men paid dues; his gale shook myriad miles.

sentences.zh: 平衡綜萬機，萬機無不理。

translations.literal: Balance levels threaded myriad pivots--myriad pivots none neglected.
translations.idiomatic: Just scales ran every hinge; no hinge ran wild.

sentences.zh: 召陵桓不君，內外何紛紛。

translations.literal: At Shaoling the lord failed sovereign duty--inner and outer how confused-confused.
translations.idiomatic: When Shaoling missed kingly duty, court and camp alike churned.

sentences.zh: 眾小便成群，蒙昧恣心，治亂不分。

translations.literal: Petty men clustered into packs--blinded they indulged whim--confusing order with chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Small men swarmed in packs, blur-eyed with whim, mistaking peace for storm.

sentences.zh: 睿聖獨斷，濟武常以文。

translations.literal: Sage wisdom alone decided--aiding martial always through culture.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred wit judged alone; martial aid rode culture.

sentences.zh: 順天惟廢立，掃霓披浮雲。

translations.literal: Following heaven only deposed and raised--sweeping rainbow cloaks, rending floating clouds.
translations.idiomatic: He obeyed heaven in raising kings and sweeping rainbow veils from drifting clouds.

sentences.zh: 雲霓既已辟，清和未幾間，羽檄首尾至，變起東南籓。

translations.literal: Rainbow vapor once cleared--pure harmony lasted scarce space--feathered summons arrived head to tail--mutiny rose southeastern fence.
translations.idiomatic: Rainbows parted; brief calm followed until courier summons poured and southeast rebelled.

sentences.zh: 儉欽為長蛇，外則憑吳蠻。

translations.literal: Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin became long serpent--without relying on Wu savages.
translations.idiomatic: Jian and Qin formed a long snake, outwardly leaning on Wu tribes.

sentences.zh: 萬國紛騷擾，戚戚天下懼不安。

translations.literal: Ten thousand lands seethed in turmoil--anxious anxious all under heaven feared unrest.
translations.idiomatic: Every realm boiled; the world shook with dread.

sentences.zh: 神武禦六軍，我皇執鉞征。

translations.literal: Divine martial commanded six armies--our emperor grasped axe on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred arms drove six hosts; our sovereign seized the axe.

sentences.zh: 儉欽起壽春，前鋒據項城。

translations.literal: Jian and Qin rose from Shouyang--van guard seized Xiang city.
translations.idiomatic: Jian and Qin erupted at Shouyang; van seized Xiangcheng.

sentences.zh: 出其不意，並縱奇兵。

translations.literal: Emerging beyond expectation--together launching prodigy troops.
translations.idiomatic: They struck unforeseen and loosed surprise hosts.

sentences.zh: 奇兵誠難禦，廟勝實難支。

translations.literal: Prodigy troops truly hard to withstand--temple victory truly hard to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Surprise columns prove hardest to stop; shrine-approved triumph hardest to bear.

sentences.zh: 兩軍不期遇，敵退計無施。

translations.literal: Two armies met unplanned--foe withdrew, stratagem had nowhere to apply.
translations.idiomatic: Both armies collided unplanned; the foe fled with plans undone.

sentences.zh: 豹騎惟武進，大戰沙陽陂。

translations.literal: Leopard riders only martial-advance--great battle at Shayang slope.
translations.idiomatic: Leopard cavalry drove straight ahead and smashed them at Shayang marsh.

sentences.zh: 欽乃亡魂走，奔虜若雲披。

translations.literal: Qin then fled lost soul--routed enemy like clouds ripped apart.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Qin's soul fled; routed foes scattered like torn clouds.

sentences.zh: 天因赦有罪，東土放鯨鯢。

translations.literal: Heaven moreover pardoned guilt--eastern soil released great villains.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven mercifully spared the guilty; the eastern march spared chief captives.

sentences.zh: 大晉篇當魏曲《天生蒸民》，古曲《四方皇》。

translations.literal: The Great Jin piece matches Wei tune 《Heaven Born the Steam Folk》, ancient tune 《Four Quarters August》.
translations.idiomatic: 《Great Jin》 pairs with Wei’s 《Heaven Sires the People》 and the old 《August Four Seas》.

sentences.zh: 赫赫大晉，于穆文王。

translations.literal: Awesome awesome Great Jin--oh solemn King Wen.
translations.idiomatic: August Great Jin; solemn blesses King Wen.

sentences.zh: 蕩蕩巍巍，道邁陶唐。

translations.literal: Vast vast, lofty lofty--Way surpasses Pottery Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Vast and towering, his Dao outruns Tao Tang.

sentences.zh: 世稱三皇五帝，及今重其光。

translations.literal: Ages titled Three Sovereigns Five Emperors--down to now doubling their radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Men hailed Three August Ones and Five Thearchs; today his brilliance doubles theirs.

sentences.zh: 九德克明，文既顯，武又彰。

translations.literal: Nine virtues mastered clarity--pattern manifest, martial also brilliant.
translations.idiomatic: Nine virtues shine clear; culture gleams and arms blaze.

sentences.zh: 思弘六合，兼濟萬方。

translations.literal: Thought to enlarge six directions--together succoring myriad directions.
translations.idiomatic: He plans to embrace six reaches and rescue every quarter.

sentences.zh: 內舉元凱，朝政以綱。

translations.literal: Within raised Yuan and Kai--court governance thereby ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Within he lifted Yuan and Kai; court rule gained its warp.

sentences.zh: 外簡武臣，時惟鷹揚。

translations.literal: Without selected martial ministers--season timely hawk-soaring.
translations.idiomatic: Without he chose generals whose hour was hawk-flight.

sentences.zh: 靡順不懷，逆命斯亡。

translations.literal: None compliant failed cherish--rebelling against mandate thus perished.
translations.idiomatic: Every compliant heart loved him; rebels against heaven died.

sentences.zh: 仁配春日，威逾秋霜。

translations.literal: Kindness pairs spring sun--awe surpasses autumn frost.
translations.idiomatic: Mercy matches spring sunlight; terror beats autumn frost.

sentences.zh: 濟濟多士，同茲蘭芳。

translations.literal: Crowded many gentlemen--together share this orchid fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Hosts of nobles throng; each shares orchid scent.

sentences.zh: 唐虞至治，四凶滔天。

translations.literal: Tang Yu utmost governance--four villains flooded heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Even Tang-Yu perfection knew four fiends who drowned heaven.

sentences.zh: 致討儉欽，罔不肅虔。

translations.literal: Launching punitive strike Jian and Qin--none failed reverent dread.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning against Jian and Qin, awe touched everyone.

sentences.zh: 化感海內，海外來賓。

translations.literal: Transformation moved within seas--beyond seas came guests.
translations.idiomatic: His reform stirred inland seas; outer seas sent guests.

sentences.zh: 獻其聲樂，並稱妾臣。

translations.literal: Presented their sound music--together styled concubine-subjects.
translations.idiomatic: They offered songs and music and styled themselves handmaids.

sentences.zh: 西蜀猾夏，僭號方域。

translations.literal: Western Shu crafty midsummer--presumptuous title regional realm.
translations.idiomatic: Western Shu plagued the heartland, claiming an outlaw throne.

sentences.zh: 命將致討，委國稽服。

translations.literal: Ordered generals launch punitive strike--entrusted state bowed in submission.
translations.idiomatic: He sent generals to punish them and Shu yielded its altars.

sentences.zh: 吳人放命，馮海阻江。

translations.literal: Wu men threw off mandate--relying on sea blocking Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: Wu men cast away heaven's charge, trusting seas and river.

sentences.zh: 飛書告喻，回應來同。

translations.literal: Flying letters proclaimed instruction--echoes answering came alike.
translations.idiomatic: Flying edicts explained justice; answering pledges arrived.

sentences.zh: 先王建萬國，九服為籓衛。

translations.literal: Former kings established myriad lands--nine robes served as fence guard.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient kings founded myriad domains; nine robes formed guard fences.

sentences.zh: 亡秦壞諸侯，序祚不二世。

translations.literal: Destroyed Qin ruined feudal lords--succession lasted no second age.
translations.idiomatic: Qin smashed feudal order; its line died in two reigns.

sentences.zh: 歷代不能復，忽逾五百歲。

translations.literal: Through dynasties could not restore--suddenly exceeding five hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: Later ages failed to restore rule until five hundred years slipped by.

sentences.zh: 我皇邁聖德，應期創典制。

translations.literal: Our emperor strides sage virtue--answering season creates canonical order.
translations.idiomatic: Our sage spans sacred virtue and founded timed institutions.

sentences.zh: 分土五等，籓國正封界。

translations.literal: Dividing soil five ranks--fence kingdoms corrected boundary seals.
translations.idiomatic: He carved five noble ranks and squared each feudal march.

sentences.zh: 莘莘文武佐，千秋遘嘉會。

translations.literal: Luxuriant civil and martial aides--thousand autumns meet auspicious assembly.
translations.idiomatic: Rich civil and martial helpers gather this blessed hour.

sentences.zh: 洪澤溢區內，仁風翔海外。

translations.literal: Flood virtue overflows within districts--kind wind flies beyond seas.
translations.idiomatic: Kind flood brims the provinces; humane breeze sails overseas.

sentences.zh: 明君篇當魏曲《為君既不易》，古曲《殿前生桂樹》。

translations.literal: The Enlightened Lord piece matches Wei tune 《For the Lord Is Already Not Easy》, ancient tune 《Before the Hall a Cassia Tree》.
translations.idiomatic: 《Enlightened Ruler》 replaces Wei’s 《To Rule Is Hard》 and 《Cassia Before the Hall》.

sentences.zh: 明君禦四海，聽鑒盡物情。

translations.literal: Enlightened lord commands four seas--listening mirror exhausts creatures' conditions.
translations.idiomatic: The wise sovereign holds the seas; his mirror drains every plea.

sentences.zh: 顧望有譴罰，謁忠身必榮。

translations.literal: Glancing brings punishment--loyal audience surely gains glory.
translations.idiomatic: One sidelong glance spells doom; loyal audiences earn honor.

sentences.zh: 蘭芷出荒野，萬里升紫庭。

translations.literal: Orchid iris emerges wilderness--ten thousand leagues mounts purple court.
translations.idiomatic: Wild orchids rise from wastes and climb the purple hall.

sentences.zh: 茨草穢堂階，掃截不得生。

translations.literal: Thistle grass fouls hall stairs--swept and cut yet cannot grow.
translations.idiomatic: Weeds choke palace stairs; cut away and still they die.

sentences.zh: 能否莫相蒙，百官正其名。

translations.literal: Able and unable none mutually veil--hundred offices correct their names.
translations.idiomatic: Merit hides from none; every bureau earns its title.

sentences.zh: 恭己慎有為，有為無不成。

translations.literal: Respectful in himself cautious having action--having action none fails succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Self-restrained care yields deeds; deeds bring success.

sentences.zh: 暗君不自信，群下執異端。

translations.literal: Dark lord lacks self-trust--hosts below clutch heterodox paths.
translations.idiomatic: A dim ruler trusts himself not; ministers seize strange roads.

sentences.zh: 正直羅浸潤，奸臣奪其權。

translations.literal: Straight ministers tangled in gradual soaking--treacherous ministers seize their power.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal men drown in soft deceit; traitors clutch authority.

sentences.zh: 雖欲盡忠誠，結舌不敢言。

translations.literal: Though wishing exhaust loyalty--tongue-tied dare not speak.
translations.idiomatic: Though craving full honesty, his tongue locks.

sentences.zh: 結舌亦何憚，盡忠為身患。

translations.literal: Tongue-tied what fear--exhausting loyalty becomes body's calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Locked lips bring dread; pure loyalty courts ruin.

sentences.zh: 清流豈不潔，飛塵濁其源。

translations.literal: Clear stream how not pure--flying dust turbids its source.
translations.idiomatic: Even clear springs foul when dust chokes the springhead.

sentences.zh: 岐路令人迷，未遠勝不還。

translations.literal: Forked roads make men lose way--not yet far yet winner cannot return.
translations.idiomatic: Crossroads confuse travelers; winners lose the road home.

sentences.zh: 忠臣立君朝，正色不顧身。

translations.literal: Loyal ministers stand in lord's court--correct color ignores self.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal ministers face the throne upright, heedless of life.

sentences.zh: 邪正不並存，譬若胡與秦。

translations.literal: Evil and straight cannot coexist--likened to Hu versus Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Evil and straight cannot share space like Hu beside Qin.

sentences.zh: 胡秦有合時，邪正各異津。

translations.literal: Hu and Qin have joining times--evil and straight different fords.
translations.idiomatic: Hu and Qin sometimes ally; evil and straight ford apart.

sentences.zh: 忠臣遇明君，乾乾惟日新。

translations.literal: Loyal minister meets enlightened lord--diligent diligent only daily renewed.
translations.idiomatic: Loyalty meets clarity and renews itself daily.

sentences.zh: 群目統在綱，眾星共北辰。

translations.literal: Crowd eyes threaded on cord--many stars share northern pivot.
translations.idiomatic: All eyes hang from one rope; stars wheel round Polaris.

sentences.zh: 設令遭暗主，斥退為凡人。

translations.literal: Suppose encountering dark lord--rejected reduced to common mortal.
translations.idiomatic: Meet a dim king and be cast common.

sentences.zh: 雖薄供時用，白茅猶為珍。

translations.literal: Though meager supplied timely use--white grass still deemed treasure.
translations.idiomatic: Mean gifts serve timely need; white straw stays sacred.

sentences.zh: 冰霜晝夜結，蘭桂摧為薪。

translations.literal: Ice frost day-night binds--orchid cassia smashed for firewood.
translations.idiomatic: Ice binds night and day; orchids burn as fuel.

sentences.zh: 邪臣多端變，用心何委曲。

translations.literal: Treacherous ministers many-ended shifting--employing heart how bent-bent.
translations.idiomatic: Villains twist many ways; their hearts coil endlessly.

sentences.zh: 便辟順情指，動隨君所欲。

translations.literal: Smooth-tongued comply mood finger--moving following lord whatever desires.
translations.idiomatic: Flatterers bend to whims and dance every wish.

sentences.zh: 偷安樂目前，不問清與濁。

translations.literal: Stealing ease delighting present eye--not asking clear versus turbid.
translations.idiomatic: They steal comfort today and never ask clean from foul.

sentences.zh: 積偽罔時主，養交以持祿。

translations.literal: Heaping falsehood deceives timely lord--nurturing faction to grasp salary.
translations.idiomatic: They pile lies for the throne and trade favors for stipends.

sentences.zh: 言行恆相違，難饜甚谿穀。

translations.literal: Speech and deed forever oppose each other--hard to sate worse than ravine gorge.
translations.idiomatic: Words and deeds split wider than valley gorges.

sentences.zh: 昧死射乾沒，覺露則滅族。

translations.literal: Blindly dare shoot dried submerged--once exposed then clan extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Blind greed hunts sunk loot; exposure wipes the clan.

sentences.zh: 拂舞，出自江左。

translations.literal: The fu brush dance issued from Jiangnan left.
translations.idiomatic: The whisk dance sprang from the eastern Jin lands.

sentences.zh: 舊雲吳舞，檢其歌，非吳辭也。

translations.literal: Formerly called Wu dance--examining its lyrics, they are not Wu language.
translations.idiomatic: Once labeled Wu dance, yet its words are not Wu speech.

sentences.zh: 亦陳於殿庭。

translations.literal: Also displayed in palace courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: It was staged in the palace yard too.

sentences.zh: 楊泓序云：「自到江南見《白符舞》，或言《白鳧鳩舞》，雲有此來數十年矣。

translations.literal: Yang Hong's preface states: "Since arriving south of Yangzi I saw 《White Talisman Dance》, some say 《White Grebe Dance》, claiming it arrived thus several decades.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Hong wrote: south of the river he watched the 《White Talisman》 dance, also called 《White Grebe》, said to have come decades ago.

sentences.zh: 察其辭旨，乃是吳人患孫皓虐政，思屬晉也。

translations.literal: Examining its theme-intent--actually Wu people loathed Sun Hao's cruel rule--thinking to attach to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Reading its intent, Wu folk hated Sun Hao's cruelty and longed for Jin.

sentences.zh: 」今列之於後雲。

translations.literal: " Now listed below.
translations.idiomatic: Their texts follow.

sentences.zh: 拂舞歌詩五篇

translations.literal: Five Fu-Brush Dance Song Poems
translations.idiomatic: Five Whisk-Dance Lyrics

sentences.zh: 白鳩篇

translations.literal: White Grebe Piece
translations.idiomatic: White Dove Piece

sentences.zh: 翩翩白鳩，再飛再鳴。

translations.literal: Flutter-flutter white dove--again flies again cries.
translations.idiomatic: Snow doves wheel and call again and again.

sentences.zh: 懷我君德，來集君庭。

translations.literal: Cherishing our lord's virtue--coming gather lord's courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: They cherish our lord's grace and gather in his yard.

sentences.zh: 白雀呈瑞，素羽明鮮。

translations.literal: White sparrow presents omen--plain feathers bright fresh.
translations.idiomatic: White finches bring omens; pale wings gleam bright.

sentences.zh: 翔庭舞翼，以應仁乾。

translations.literal: Soaring courtyard dancing wings--responding benevolent heaven.
translations.idiomatic: They dance the court, answering humane heaven.

sentences.zh: 皎皎鳴鳩，或丹或黃。

translations.literal: Bright bright calling turtledoves--some cinnabar some yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Bright turtledoves call, some red, some gold.

sentences.zh: 樂我君惠，振羽來翔。

translations.literal: Delighting in our lord's kindness--ruffling feathers come soar.
translations.idiomatic: They rejoice in kindness and beat wings in flight.

sentences.zh: 東壁餘光，魚在江湖。

translations.literal: East wall leftover glow--fish in river lake.
translations.idiomatic: East wall keeps borrowed light; fish roam lakes free.

sentences.zh: 惠而不費，敬我微軀。

translations.literal: Kind yet not wasteful--honoring my humble body.
translations.idiomatic: His bounty costs little yet honors my slight frame.

sentences.zh: 策我良駟，習我驅馳。

translations.literal: Whipping my fine steeds--training my galloping.
translations.idiomatic: He spurs good horses and drills my riding.

sentences.zh: 與君周旋，樂道忘饑。

translations.literal: Turning with lord many rounds--delighting in Way forgetting hunger.
translations.idiomatic: We circle our lord, drunk on teaching, forgetting hunger.

sentences.zh: 我心虛靜，我志沾濡。

translations.literal: My heart empty quiet--my aim soaked through.
translations.idiomatic: My heart stays empty still; my purpose drinks deep.

sentences.zh: 彈琴鼓瑟，聊以自娛。

translations.literal: Strumming qin thrumming se--just using to entertain self.
translations.idiomatic: We pluck qin and strike se for pastime.

sentences.zh: 陵雲登臺，浮游太清。

translations.literal: Mounting clouds ascending terrace--floating roaming Grand Clarity.
translations.idiomatic: We climb cloud terraces and drift through Grand Clarity.

sentences.zh: 攀龍附鳳，自望身輕。

translations.literal: Climbing dragon attaching phoenix--self hoping body light.
translations.idiomatic: We cling to dragon and phoenix and hope to rise weightless.

sentences.zh: 濟濟篇

translations.literal: Crowded Crowded Piece
translations.idiomatic: Splendid Splendid Piece

sentences.zh: 暢暢飛舞氣流芳，追念三五大綺黃。

translations.literal: Joyful joyful flying dance breath flows fragrance--recalling three five vast splendid yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Joyous dancers whirl perfume; memory reaches wise kings of old.

sentences.zh: 去失有，時可行，去來時同此未央。

translations.literal: Depart lose having--times may practice--depart arrive times together this never-ending.
translations.idiomatic: Loss and gain keep season; come and go share this endless round.

sentences.zh: 時冉冉，近桑榆，但當飲酒為歡娛。

translations.literal: Season slowly slowly--near mulberry elm--only ought drink wine for merry pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: Hours hasten toward dusk; best seize wine and pleasure.

sentences.zh: 衰老逝，有何期，多憂耿耿內懷思，深池曠，魚獨希，願得黃浦眾所依。

translations.literal: Declining old passes--having what span--much worry gleaming bright within cherishing thought--deep pool vast--fish alone sparse--wish obtain Huangpu crowds place rely.
translations.idiomatic: Age steals life with no fixed term; grief lodges deep; wide ponds hold lonely fish who seek the harbor crowd.

sentences.zh: 恩感人，世無比，悲歌且舞無極已。

translations.literal: Grace moves people--world none compare--sorrow song moreover dance without limit ended.
translations.idiomatic: Grace touches beyond compare; sorrow lifts song and endless dance.

sentences.zh: 獨祿篇

translations.literal: Solitary Fortune Piece
translations.idiomatic: Outcast Fortune Piece

sentences.zh: 獨獨祿祿，水深泥濁。

translations.literal: Lonely lonely fortune fortune--water deep mud turbid.
translations.idiomatic: Lonely roads, lonely fate; deep water, foul mud.

sentences.zh: 泥濁尚可，水深殺我。

translations.literal: Mud turbid still tolerable--water deep kills me.
translations.idiomatic: Filthy mud one might bear; deep waters drown me.

sentences.zh: 雍雍雙雁，遊戲田畔。

translations.literal: Harmonious harmonious paired geese--sporting field edges.
translations.idiomatic: Twin geese glide together; they sport along field rims.

sentences.zh: 我欲射雁，念子孤散。

translations.literal: I wish shoot geese--thinking you solitary scattered.
translations.idiomatic: I mean to shoot them yet pity your lonely wandering.

sentences.zh: 翩翩浮萍，得風搖輕。

translations.literal: Flutter-flutter floating duckweed--catching wind sways light.
translations.idiomatic: Drifting duckweed catches breeze and dances light.

sentences.zh: 我心何合，與之同並。

translations.literal: My heart what joins--together with it same merged.
translations.idiomatic: My heart seeks union and merges with yours.

sentences.zh: 空床低幃，誰知無人。

translations.literal: Empty bed low curtain--who knows no person.
translations.idiomatic: Low curtains veil empty beds; none guess who lies within.

sentences.zh: 夜衣錦繡，誰別偽真。

translations.literal: Night clothes brocade embroidery--who distinguishes false true.
translations.idiomatic: Night robes shine silk; who tells sham from true.

sentences.zh: 刀鳴鞘中，倚床無施。

translations.literal: Knife sings within scabbard--leaning bed no place deploy.
translations.idiomatic: Blades hum in sheaths beside beds unused.

sentences.zh: 父冤不報，欲活何為。

translations.literal: Father's wrong unavenged--wishing live what for.
translations.idiomatic: Father's murder unpaid--why stay alive?

sentences.zh: 猛獸班班，遊戲山間。

translations.literal: Fierce beasts striped striped--sporting mountain midst.
translations.idiomatic: Striped beasts roam hills for sport.

sentences.zh: 獸欲齧人，不避豪賢。

translations.literal: Beast wishes bite men--not avoiding heroic worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Savage beasts attack without sparing heroes.

sentences.zh: 碣石篇

translations.literal: Jieshi Piece
translations.idiomatic: Stone Tablet Piece

sentences.zh: 東臨碣石，以觀滄海。

translations.literal: East ascends Jieshi--thereby gaze blue sea.
translations.idiomatic: Eastward we climb Jieshi to watch the gray sea.

sentences.zh: 水何淡淡，山島竦峙。

translations.literal: Waters how ripple-ripple--mountain islets steep-standing.
translations.idiomatic: Waters shimmer softly; islands thrust from the tide.

sentences.zh: 樹木叢生，百草豐茂。

translations.literal: Trees and shrubs cluster thick--hundred grasses lush and dense.
translations.idiomatic: Groves crowd together; every meadow runs riot green.

sentences.zh: 秋風蕭瑟，洪波湧起。

translations.literal: Autumn wind bleak-rustling--great waves surge rising.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn wind sighs; giant billows lift.

sentences.zh: 日月之行，若出其中。

translations.literal: Traveling of sun and moon--as if emerging from within it.
translations.idiomatic: Sun and moon seem born inside its swell.

sentences.zh: 星漢燦爛，若出其裏。

translations.literal: Star-river splendid bright--as if emerging from inside it.
translations.idiomatic: The Milky Way glitters as though poured from its depths.

sentences.zh: 幸甚至哉，歌以詠志。

translations.literal: How extreme the fortune--song thereby chants intent.
translations.idiomatic: Such bliss, such grace—this song voices the heart.

sentences.zh: 《觀滄海》

translations.literal: 《Gazing the Blue Sea》
translations.idiomatic: 'Gazing the Azure Sea'

sentences.zh: 孟冬十月，北風徘徊。

translations.literal: Meng-winter tenth month--north wind lingers.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month of cold winter; north wind hesitates.

sentences.zh: 天氣肅清，繁霜霏霏。

translations.literal: Sky breath solemn pure--thick frost drifts drifting.
translations.idiomatic: Air turns crisp and thin; heavy frost drifts down.

sentences.zh: 鶤雞晨鳴，雁過南飛。

translations.literal: Kun-cock crows at dawn--geese pass flying south.
translations.idiomatic: Wild cock crows at dawn; wild geese fly south.

sentences.zh: 鷙鳥潛藏，熊羆窟棲。

translations.literal: Raptor birds hide away--bears and brown bears hole-dwell.
translations.idiomatic: Birds of prey hide; bears and brown beasts hole up.

sentences.zh: 耨鑮停置，農收積場。

translations.literal: Hoes and sickles set aside--farm harvest piled yards.
translations.idiomatic: Plow shares rest; grain heaps fill the threshing ground.

sentences.zh: 逆旅整設，以通賈商。

translations.literal: Inns fully arranged--thereby thoroughfare merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Roadside inns stand ready for traveling traders.

sentences.zh: 幸甚至哉，歌以詠志。

translations.literal: How extreme the fortune--song thereby chants intent.
translations.idiomatic: Such bliss, such grace—this song voices the heart.

sentences.zh: 《冬十月》

translations.literal: 《Winter Tenth Month》
translations.idiomatic: 'Winter's Tenth Month'

sentences.zh: 鄉土不同，河朔隆塞。

translations.literal: Native soil not alike--north of Yellow River cold-constricted.
translations.idiomatic: Soils differ: north of the river lies bitter cold.

sentences.zh: 流澌浮漂，舟船行難。

translations.literal: Drifting ice floats bob--boats and ships travel hard.
translations.idiomatic: Ice floes drift; boats struggle upstream.

sentences.zh: 錐不之地，豐籟深奧。

translations.literal: Pick cannot pierce earth--lush growth deep and hidden.
translations.idiomatic: Spades bite shallow; thick growth hides deep hollows.

sentences.zh: 水竭不流，冰堅可蹈。

translations.literal: Waters drained cease flowing--ice solid can tread.
translations.idiomatic: Streams freeze solid; ice bears a man's tread.

sentences.zh: 士隱者貧，勇俠輕非。

translations.literal: Knights reclusive are poor--brave bravos slight wrong lightly.
translations.idiomatic: Hidden scholars stay poor; brash heroes scorn blame.

sentences.zh: 心常歎怨，戚戚多悲。

translations.literal: Heart always sighs resentment--anxious anxious much sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: Hearts simmer blame; sorrow lodges everywhere.

sentences.zh: 幸甚至哉，歌以詠志。

translations.literal: How extreme the fortune--song thereby chants intent.
translations.idiomatic: Such bliss, such grace—this song voices the heart.

sentences.zh: 《土不同》

translations.literal: 《Soil Not Alike》
translations.idiomatic: 'How Alien the Soil'

sentences.zh: 神龜雖壽，猶有竟時。

translations.literal: Spirit tortoise though long-lived--still has ending time.
translations.idiomatic: Even sacred tortoises end.

sentences.zh: 騰蛇乘霧，終為土灰。

translations.literal: Soaring serpent rides mist--in the end becomes soil ash.
translations.idiomatic: Flying serpents ride mist yet turn to dust.

sentences.zh: 驥老伏櫪，志在千里。

translations.literal: Swift steed old lies stall--ambition still thousand leagues.
translations.idiomatic: Old stallions in their stalls keep hearts on distant roads.

sentences.zh: 烈士暮年，壯心不已。

translations.literal: Stalwart men in twilight years--fierce hearts do not cease.
translations.idiomatic: Heroes in evening years still burn undimmed.

sentences.zh: 盈縮之期，不但在天。

translations.literal: Full and empty seasons--not only heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Life's span rests not on heaven alone.

sentences.zh: 養怡之福，可得永年。

translations.literal: Nurturing joy's blessing--can obtain long years.
translations.idiomatic: Guarding quiet joy wins long life.

sentences.zh: 幸甚至哉，歌以詠志。

translations.literal: How extreme the fortune--song thereby chants intent.
translations.idiomatic: Such bliss, such grace—this song voices the heart.

sentences.zh: 《龜雖壽》

translations.literal: 《Though the Tortoise Lives Long》
translations.idiomatic: 'Though Turtles Live Long'

sentences.zh: 淮南王篇

translations.literal: Prince of Huainan piece
translations.idiomatic: Song of the Prince of Huainan

sentences.zh: 淮南王，自言尊，百尺高樓與天連。

translations.literal: Prince of Huainan--self-called honored--hundred-foot high tower connects with heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The prince of Huainan styled himself supreme; his tower climbed skyward.

sentences.zh: 後園鑿井銀作床，金瓶素綆汲寒漿。

translations.literal: Rear garden bored well silver makes bed--gold jar plain rope draws cold broth.
translations.idiomatic: His rear garden well sported silver decking; golden jars on pale cords drew icy water.

sentences.zh: 汲寒漿，飲少年，少年窈窕何能賢。

translations.literal: Drawing cold broth--drinking youth--youth graceful how can worthy.
translations.idiomatic: They drew chill liquor for fair youths—graceful boys praised as sages.

sentences.zh: 揚聲悲歌音絕天。

translations.literal: Raising voice mournful song tone cuts heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Their mournful voices tore the clouds.

sentences.zh: 我欲渡河河無梁，願作雙黃鵠，還故鄉。

translations.literal: I wish cross river river no bridge--wish become paired yellow swans--return native village.
translations.idiomatic: I long to ford yet find no bridge; I would turn paired swans and fly home.

sentences.zh: 還故鄉，入故里，徘徊故鄉，若身不已。

translations.literal: Return native village--enter native hamlet--linger native village--as body cannot stop.
translations.idiomatic: Home again, lane again—yet roaming never ends.

sentences.zh: 繁舞奇歌無不泰，徘徊桑梓遊天外。

translations.literal: Splendid dance strange songs none not joyous--linger mulberry catalpa roam heaven beyond.
translations.idiomatic: Wild dances and shrill songs knew no restraint; they drifted past heaven itself.

sentences.zh: 鼓角橫吹曲。

translations.literal: Drum-and-horn crosswind suite.
translations.idiomatic: Music of drums and horns on the crossroads breeze.

sentences.zh: 鼓，案《周禮》「以ＧＷ鼓鼓軍事」。

translations.literal: Drums: According to Zhou li 'use thunder-drums for military affairs.'
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou canon pairs thunder-drums with warfare.

sentences.zh: 角，說者雲，蚩尤氏帥魑魅與黃帝戰于涿鹿，帝乃始命吹角為龍鳴以禦之。

translations.literal: Horns: Expositors say Chiyou led demon-spirits and battled Yellow Emperor at Zhuolu--Emperor then first ordered horns blown as dragon-cry to withstand them.
translations.idiomatic: Legend says Chiyou led spirits against the Yellow Emperor at Zhuolu, so the emperor mimicked dragons with horns.

sentences.zh: 其後魏武北征烏丸，越沙漠而軍士思歸，於是減為中鳴，而尤更悲矣。

translations.literal: Afterward Wei Wu northern campaigned Wuhuan--crossed desert and soldiers longed home--thereupon reduced to middle cry--yet became even more mournful.
translations.idiomatic: When Cao Cao marched against the Wuhuan across sand, homesick troops cut the call to mid-register, yet it grew sadder.

sentences.zh: 胡角者，本以應胡笳之聲，後漸用之橫吹，有雙角，即胡樂也。

translations.literal: Hu horns originally answered Hu reed-pipe sounds--later gradually used in crosswind blowing--having paired horns--that is Hu music.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier horns matched reed pipes, then joined crosswind ensembles—paired pipes meant Hu tunes.

sentences.zh: 張博望入西域，傳其法於西京，惟得《摩訶兜勒》一曲。

translations.literal: Zhang Bowang entered Western Regions--transmitted its methods to western capital--only obtained 《Mahā-dūra》 one melody.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qian brought its method west but brought back only the 《Mahā-dūra》 tune.

sentences.zh: 李延年因胡曲更造新聲二十八解，乘輿以為武樂。

translations.literal: Li Yan-nian following Hu tunes newly fashioned twenty-eight solutions--imperial conveyance took them as martial music.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yannian reworked Hu songs into twenty-eight suites for imperial martial performance.

sentences.zh: 後漢以給邊將，和帝時，萬人將軍得用之。

translations.literal: Later Han supplied border generals--during He Emperor times--ten-thousand-man generals could use them.
translations.idiomatic: Later Han gave them to frontier commanders; under Emperor He only hosts above ten thousand might play them.

sentences.zh: 魏晉以來，二十八解不復具存，用者有《黃鵠》、《隴頭》、《出關》、《入關》、《出塞》、《入塞》、《折楊柳》、《黃覃子》、《赤之楊》、《望行人》十曲。

translations.literal: Since Wei-Jin twenty-eight solutions no longer wholly survive--among users remain 《Yellow Swan》, 《Longshank》, 《Out Pass》, 《Enter Pass》, 《Out Frontier》, 《Enter Frontier》, 《Breaking Willow》, 《Yellow Tanzi》, 《Red Poplar》, 《Gazing Travelers》 ten melodies.
translations.idiomatic: After Wei and Jin only ten suites survived from twenty-eight: 《Yellow Swan》 through 《Watching Travelers》.

sentences.zh: 案魏晉之世，有孫氏善弘舊曲，宋識善擊節唱和，陳左善清歌，列和善吹笛，郝索善彈箏，硃生善琵琶，尤發新聲。

translations.literal: Examining Wei-Jin generations there was Sun clan skilled spreading old melodies--Song Shi skilled beating rhythm singing harmony--Chen Zuo skilled pure singing--Lie He skilled blowing flute--Hao Suo skilled plucking zheng--Zhu Sheng skilled pipa--especially issuing new sounds.
translations.idiomatic: Wei-Jin courts knew Sun's old tunes, Song Shi's beat, Chen Zuo's voice, Lie He's flute, Hao Suo's zheng, Zhu Sheng's pipa—each birthing fresh sound.

sentences.zh: 故傅玄著書曰：「人若欽所聞而忽所見，不亦惑乎？

translations.literal: Therefore Fu Xuan composed book stating: "People if admire what they hear yet neglect what they see--is it not deluded?
translations.idiomatic: Fu Xuan wrote: favoring rumor over sight is folly.

sentences.zh: 設此六人生於上世，越今古而無儷，何但夔牙同契哉！

translations.literal: Suppose these six men born on high antiquity--surpassing modern and ancient without peer--how only Kui and Ya share tally!
translations.idiomatic: Had those six lived in high antiquity they would dwarf every age—far beyond matching Kui or Boya.

sentences.zh: 」案此說，則自茲以後，皆孫硃等之遺則也。

translations.literal: " Examining this explanation--then from hereafter all follow Sun-Zhu and company's transmitted patterns.
translations.idiomatic: Hence later musicians walked Sun and Zhu's path.

sentences.zh: 相和，漢舊歌也，絲竹更相和，執節者歌。

translations.literal: Xianghe--Han old songs--silk and bamboo alternately harmonize--baton-holder sings.
translations.idiomatic: Antiphonal song was Han tradition: strings and winds answered while the director sang.

sentences.zh: 本一部，魏明帝分為二，更遞夜宿。

translations.literal: Originally one section--Wei Mingdi split into two--alternating night duty.
translations.idiomatic: One ensemble became two under Mingdi, alternating night watches.

sentences.zh: 本十七曲，硃生、宋職、列和等復合之為十三曲。

translations.literal: Originally seventeen pieces--Zhu Sheng, Song Zhi, Lie He et al. recombined into thirteen pieces.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen songs shrank to thirteen when Zhu Sheng, Song Zhi, and Lie He merged them.

sentences.zh: 但歌，四曲，出自漢世。

translations.literal: But songs--four pieces--issued from Han age.
translations.idiomatic: Bare voice songs—four pieces—came from Han.

sentences.zh: 無弦節，作伎最先唱，一人唱，三人和。

translations.literal: Lacking string rhythm--performers first sing--one person sings--three persons harmonize.
translations.idiomatic: No strings keep time: a lead voice opens and three answer.

sentences.zh: 魏武帝尤好之。

translations.literal: Wei Wudi especially loved them.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Cao adored them.

sentences.zh: 時有宋容華者，清澈好聲，善唱此曲，當時之特妙。

translations.literal: At time was Song Ronghua--clear pure lovely voice--skilled singing this tune--then-age supreme marvel.
translations.idiomatic: Song Ronghua sang them with crystalline beauty—the marvel of her day.

sentences.zh: 自晉以來不復傳，遂絕。

translations.literal: Since Jin no longer transmitted--thereupon cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Jin lost the tradition and it died.

sentences.zh: 凡樂章古辭，今之存者，並漢世街陌謠謳，《江南可採蓮》、《烏生十五子》、《白頭吟》之屬也。

translations.literal: Generally musical chapter ancient lyrics--what survives today--together Han-age lane street ballads--《Southland May Gather Lotuses》, 《Crow Bears Fifteen Chicks》, 《White Hair Song》 types.
translations.idiomatic: Surviving lyrics are Han street songs like 《Lotus Picking in the South》.

sentences.zh: 吳歌雜曲並出江南，東晉以來，稍有增廣。

translations.literal: Wu songs miscellaneous melodies altogether issued south of Yangzi--Eastern Jin onward slightly expanded.
translations.idiomatic: Wu songs rose from the Jiangnan; Eastern Jin widened the set.

sentences.zh: 《子夜歌》者，女子名子夜，造此聲。

translations.literal: 《Midnight Song》: woman named Ziye fashioned this sound.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Midnight Song》 came from a woman called Ziye.

sentences.zh: 孝武太元中，琅邪王軻之家有鬼歌《子夜》，則子夜是此時以前人也。

translations.literal: Xiaowu Taiyuan era Langye Wang Ke's household had ghost singing 《Midnight》--thereby Ziye was person before this time.
translations.idiomatic: A ghost sang 《Midnight》 in Wang Ke's house under Xiaowu, so Ziye lived earlier.

sentences.zh: 《鳳將雛歌》者，舊曲也。

translations.literal: 《Phoenix Leads Chicks Song》: old melody.
translations.idiomatic: 《Phoenix Tending Its Chicks》 is an ancient tune.

sentences.zh: 應璩《百一詩》云「言是《鳳將雛》」，然則其來久矣。

translations.literal: Ying Qu's 《Hundred-and-One Poem》 states 'speech says 《Phoenix Leads Chicks》'--clearly it came long past.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Qu's verse names it, proof of great age.

sentences.zh: 《前溪歌》者，車騎將軍沈充所制。

translations.literal: 《Front Brook Song》: crafted by chariot general Shen Chong.
translations.idiomatic: General Shen Chong wrote 《Front Brook》.

sentences.zh: 《阿子》及《歡聞歌》者，穆帝升平初，歌畢輒呼「阿子，汝聞不？

translations.literal: 《Ah Youth》 and 《Joy Heard Song》: Emperor Mu Shengping early--after songs finished then cried 'Ah youth--have you heard or not?
translations.idiomatic: 《Ah, Lad》 and 《Heard Joy》: after Mu-era songs someone shouted 'Child, did you hear?'

sentences.zh: 」語在《五行志》。

translations.literal: " Story lies in 《Treatise on Five Phases》.
translations.idiomatic: The tale sits in the Five Phases treatise.

sentences.zh: 後人衍其聲，以為此二曲。

translations.literal: Later people extended its sound--thereby fashioned these two melodies.
translations.idiomatic: People spun new lyrics from that shout.

sentences.zh: 《團扇歌》者，中書令王瑉與嫂婢有情，愛好甚篤，嫂捶撻婢過苦，婢素善歌，而瑉好捉白團扇，故制此歌。

translations.literal: 《Round Fan Song》: Palace Writer Wang Min and sister-in-law's maid had affair--love fond exceptionally thick--sister-in-law flogged maid too cruelly--maid plain skilled singing--and Min fond grasping white round fan--therefore fashioned this song.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Min loved his sister-in-law's maid; she sang while he flourished a white fan—hence the 《Round Fan》 ballad.

sentences.zh: 《懊憹歌》者，隆安初俗聞訛謠之曲，語在《五行志》。

translations.literal: 《Chagrined Song》: Long'an early vulgar hearsay corrupted ballad--story lies in 《Treatise on Five Phases》.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Chagrin》 tune arose from Long'an gossip recorded in the Five Phases treatise.

sentences.zh: 《長史變》者，司徒左長史王廞臨敗所制。

translations.literal: 《Registrar's Lament》: crafted by Minister Registrar Wang Yin facing defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yin composed 《Registrar's Lament》 on the eve of ruin.

sentences.zh: 凡此諸曲，始皆徒歌，即而被之管弦。

translations.literal: Generally these various melodies--first all walking songs--thereupon clothed with wind strings.
translations.idiomatic: They began as plain voice, then gained accompaniment.

sentences.zh: 又有因絲竹金石，造歌以被之，魏世三調歌辭之類是也。

translations.literal: Moreover there is following silk bamboo metal stone--fashioning songs to clothe them--Wei-age three-mode song lyrics types are this.
translations.idiomatic: Wei-period triple-mode lyrics dressed instrumental suites.

sentences.zh: 《杯柈舞》，案太康中天下為《晉世寧舞》，務手以接杯柈反覆之。

translations.literal: 《Cup-Tray Dance》: examining Taikang era realm crafted 《Age of Jin Peace Dance》--busy hands catch cup trays flipping them.
translations.idiomatic: Taikang revelers juggled cups and trays to the 《Jin at Peace》 tune.

sentences.zh: 此則漢世惟有

translations.literal: By this account Han times had only
translations.idiomatic: The Han tradition knew only

sentences.zh: 柈舞，而晉加之以杯，反覆之也。

translations.literal: the tray dance, while Jin added cups, flipping them again.
translations.idiomatic: tray juggling until Jin added cups and flips.

sentences.zh: 《公莫舞》，今之《巾舞》也。

translations.literal: 《Lord Take No Dance》, today's 《Scarf Dance》.
translations.idiomatic: 《Lord, Stay Your Hand》 became today's scarf dance.

sentences.zh: 相傳云項莊劍舞，項伯以袖隔之，使不得害漢高祖，且語項莊云「公莫」！

translations.literal: Tradition says Xiang Zhuang sword-danced--Xiang Bo used sleeve to block--making him unable to harm Han High Ancestor--and told Xiang Zhuang saying 'Lord take no'!
translations.idiomatic: Legend has Xiang Zhuang feinting at Gaozu until Xiang Bo blocked with his sleeve.

sentences.zh: 古人相呼曰公，言公莫害漢王也。

translations.literal: Ancient people called each other lord--saying lord take no harm Han king.
translations.idiomatic: Men cried 'sir, spare the king of Han.'

sentences.zh: 今之用巾蓋像項伯衣袖之遺式。

translations.literal: Today's use of scarf probably images Xiang Bo sleeve legacy pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Kerchiefs echo Xiang Bo's lifted sleeve.

sentences.zh: 然案《琴操》有《公莫渡河曲》，然則其聲所從來已久，俗雲項伯，非也。

translations.literal: Yet examining 《Qin Cao》 has 《Lord Take No Crossing River Melody》--clearly its sound came long ago--folk saying Xiang Bo--not correct.
translations.idiomatic: Yet 《Qin Cao》 already lists 《Lord, Cross Not the River》—older than Xiang Bo.

sentences.zh: 《白糸寧舞》，案舞辭有巾袍之言。

translations.literal: 《White Ramie Dance》: examining dance lyrics contain scarf-gown speech.
translations.idiomatic: 《White Ramie》 lyrics mention scarves and robes.

sentences.zh: 糸甯本吳地所出，宜是吳舞也。

translations.literal: Ramie cloth originally Wu region produces--appropriate should be Wu dance.
translations.idiomatic: White ramie cloth comes from Wu—likely a Wu dance.

sentences.zh: 晉《俳歌》又云：「皎皎白緒，節節為雙。

translations.literal: Jin 《Comic Song》 again states: "Bright bright white fiber--joint joint forming pairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jin's comic lyrics sing 'gleaming white threads paired each knot.'

sentences.zh: 」吳音呼緒為糸甯，疑白糸甯即白緒也。

translations.literal: " Wu accent calls fiber ramie--suspect white ramie is white fiber.
translations.idiomatic: Wu speech turns 'threads' into 'ramie'—probably the same cloth.

sentences.zh: 《鐸舞歌》一篇，《幡舞歌》一篇，《鼓舞伎》六曲，並陳於元會。

translations.literal: 《Bell Dance Song》 one piece,《Banner Dance Song》 one piece,《Drum Dance Skill》 six melodies--together displayed at Great Audience.
translations.idiomatic: Bell dance, banner dance, six drum acts—all appeared at New Year.

sentences.zh: 後漢正旦，天子臨德陽殿受朝賀，舍利從西方來，戲於殿前，激水化成比目魚，跳躍嗽水，作霧翳日。

translations.literal: Later Han New Year's dawn Son of Heaven approached Deyang Hall receiving court congratulations--sarīra came from west--sporting before hall--splashing water transformed into paired-flat fish--leaping jumping spurting water--making mist covering sun.
translations.idiomatic: Han New Year brought western relic tricks—sprayed water turned to fish that leaped through mist.

sentences.zh: 畢，又化成龍，長八九丈，出水遊戲，炫耀日光。

translations.literal: Finished--again transformed dragon--long eight or nine rods--emerging water sporting--dazzling sunlight.
translations.idiomatic: Then spray became dragons eighty feet long sporting in sunlight.

sentences.zh: 以兩大絲繩系兩柱頭，相去數丈，兩倡女對舞，行於繩上，相逢切肩而不傾。

translations.literal: Using two great silk ropes tied two pillar tops--apart several rods--two singing girls paired dancing--walking on ropes--meeting cutting shoulders yet not leaning.
translations.idiomatic: Tightrope dancers met midair on twin ropes.

sentences.zh: 魏晉訖江左，猶有《夏育扛鼎》、《巨象行乳》、《神龜抃舞》、《背負靈嶽》、《桂樹白雪》、《畫地成川》之樂。

translations.literal: Wei-Jin down to Jiangnan still had 《Summer Yu Shoulders Tripod》, 《Giant Elephant Nursing》, 《Spirit Tortoise Clap Dance》, 《Back Bearing Spirit Peak》, 《Cassia Tree White Snow》, 《Scratching Earth Makes River》 pleasures.
translations.idiomatic: Wei-Jin courts kept acts like Yu hoisting cauldrons or painting rivers on dust.

sentences.zh: 成帝咸康七年，尚書蔡謨奏：「八年正會儀注，惟作鼓吹鐘鼓，其餘伎樂盡不作。

translations.literal: Emperor Cheng Xianhe seventh year Minister Cai Mo memorialized: "Eighth year Great Audience protocol--only perform wind-drums bells--remaining skill music entirely not perform.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianhe 7 Cai Mo asked to strip the gala to drums alone.

sentences.zh: 」侍中張澄、給事黃門侍郎陳逵駁，以為「王者觀時設教，至於吉凶殊斷，不易之道也。

translations.literal: " Attendant Zhang Cheng and Gentleman Chen Kui objected--thinking 'king observes season establishing teaching--as for auspicious and inauspicious separate judgement--unchanging Way.'
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cheng and Chen Kui argued kings tune ritual to the times.

sentences.zh: 今四方觀禮，陵有儐吊之位，庭奏宮懸之樂，二禮兼用，哀樂不分，體國經制，莫大於此」。

translations.literal: Now four quarters observe ritual--tomb has condolence positions--court performs suspended palace music--two rites together employ--mourning music not distinguished--ordering state canon--nothing greater than this.'
translations.idiomatic: Guests saw mourning at tombs yet heard banquet music—no line between grief and joy.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「今既以天下體大，禮從權宜，三正之饗，宜盡用吉禮也。

translations.literal: Edict stated: "Now already taking realm body great--ritual follows expedient weight--three prime offerings feasts--ought entirely use auspicious ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The throne answered: grand occasions warrant festive rite.

sentences.zh: 至娛耳目之樂，所不忍聞，故闕之耳。

translations.literal: As for pleasing ear-eye music--what heart cannot bear hear--therefore omit it ear.
translations.idiomatic: Ear candy may shame the throne, so cut novelties.

sentences.zh: 事之大者，不過上壽酒，稱萬歲，已許其大，不足復闕鐘鼓鼓吹也。」

translations.literal: Affairs greatest--not exceeding presenting longevity wine--calling ten thousand years--already permitting its greatness--not sufficient again omit bells drums wind blowing.'
translations.idiomatic: Yet toasting long life already honors the court—need not silence drums.

sentences.zh: 澄、逵又啟：「今大禮雖降，事吉於朝。

translations.literal: Cheng and Kui again stated: "Now great ritual though lowered--affairs auspicious at court.
translations.idiomatic: They replied: morning court stays joyous.

sentences.zh: 然儐吊顯於園陵，則未滅有哀；

translations.literal: Yet condolence manifest at imperial tombs--then not extinguished having mourning;
translations.idiomatic: But imperial tombs still host lament—

sentences.zh: 禮服定于典文，義無盡吉。

translations.literal: ritual garments fixed in canonical texts--meaning none exhaustively auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: canonical dress codes never turn wholly festive.

sentences.zh: 是以咸寧之會，有撤樂之典，實先朝稽古憲章，垂式萬世者也。

translations.literal: Therefore at the Xianning court gathering there existed the precedent of curtailing music--truly the former dynasty's antiquarian statutes, a model suspended for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the Xianning assembly established the rule of stripping spectacle music: an archaic precedent meant to bind every future reign.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「若元日大饗，萬國朝宗，庭廢鐘鼓之奏，遂闕起居之節，朝無磬制之音，賓無蹈履之度，其於事義，不亦闕乎！

translations.literal: The edict replied: "If on the Yuan-day feast myriad states come to court yet the yard sets aside bells and drums, then the rituals of rising and resting lapse; the court lacks clear pitched music and guests lose measured tread--surely such emptiness wounds the very meaning of the rite!"
translations.idiomatic: The throne answered: cancel drums at the New Year audience and you lose every ceremonial beat—how could that honor the gathering?

sentences.zh: 惟可量輕重，以制事中。」

translations.literal: Only weigh light against heavy and settle what the moment requires."
translations.idiomatic: Balance solemnity against joy and fix what mid-course ritual demands."

sentences.zh: 散騎侍郎顧臻表曰：「臣聞聖王制樂，讚揚政道，養以仁義，防其淫佚，上享宗廟，下訓黎元，體五行之正音，協八風以陶物。

translations.literal: Gentleman-attendant Gu Zhen presented a memorial: "I have heard that sage kings fashion music to praise governance, nurture it with humaneness and duty, guard against excess, feast the ancestors above and instruct the common people below, embody the true tones of the five phases, and align the eight winds to mold all creatures.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Zhen argued that wise rulers tuned music to politics—feeding ritual with benevolence, defending against decadence, linking temple and folk, matching the five notes and eight winds.

sentences.zh: 宮聲正方而好義，角聲堅齊而率禮，弦歌鐘鼓金石之作備矣。

translations.literal: The gong mode stands square and loves righteousness; the jue mode stays taut and orderly, guiding ritual--thus strings, songs, bells, drums, and bronze stones achieve completeness.
