translations.idiomatic: The gong pitch stays upright and just; the jue pitch cuts clean and keeps ceremony—so strings, voices, and percussion complete the spectrum.

sentences.zh: 故通神至化，有率舞之感，移風易俗，致和樂之極。

translations.literal: Therefore spirit penetrates and transformation reaches utmost--there are sensations that draw forth dance; customs shift and winds change until harmony reaches its peak.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the gods respond and transformation runs deep—dance arises naturally and manners change until music touches perfection.

sentences.zh: 末世之伎，設禮外之觀，逆行連倒，頭足入筥之屬，皮膚外剝，肝心內摧，敦彼行葦，猶謂勿踐，矧伊生靈，而不側愴。

translations.literal: But tricks of a decadent age set spectacles outside ritual--backward walks, chained somersaults, stuffing head and feet into jars--flaying skin without and tearing liver-heart within; thick stands of rushes we still refuse to trample--how much more living souls whom we cannot pity?
translations.idiomatic: Late-age acrobatics staged freak shows beyond ritual—inverted capers, bodies folded into baskets—tearing flesh and hearts while even roadside reeds were spared; could sovereigns stomach cruelty to living beings?

sentences.zh: 加四海朝覲，言觀帝庭，耳聆《雅》《頌》之聲，目睹威儀之序，足以蹋天，頭以履地，反天地之至順，傷彝倫之大方。

translations.literal: Add to that audiences from the four seas who come to scan the imperial court: ears should hear 《Ya》 and 《Song》, eyes should witness august deportment--yet these acts invite men to stride heaven with their soles and tread earth with their crowns, overturning heaven and earth's proper submission and marring the great norms of human relations.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign lords hear classical hymns yet watch freakish tumblers—feet stamping heaven, crowns grinding earth—inverting cosmic order and insulting every moral bond.

sentences.zh: 今夷狄對岸，外禦為急，兵食七升，忘身赴難，過泰之戲，日廩五斗。

translations.literal: Today barbarians face us across the river; outer defense is urgent--soldiers subsist on seven sheng of grain while risking death, yet Taixi entertainments consume five dou of stipend each day.
translations.idiomatic: While barbarians mass beyond the stream, troops scrape by on seven sheng rations and hazard their lives, court jesters still swallow five dou a day for decadent plays.

sentences.zh: 方掃神州，經略中甸，若此之事，不可示遠。

translations.literal: We are still sweeping the heartland and charting the central plain--such sights cannot be displayed to distant peoples.
translations.idiomatic: With the interior still unsettled, these displays cannot face foreign eyes.

sentences.zh: 宜下太常，纂備雅樂，簫《韶》九成，惟新于盛運，功德頌聲，永著于來葉，此乃所以'燕及皇天，克昌厥後'者也。

translations.literal: Command the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to compile complete ya music so that panpipes may sound 《Shao》 through nine movements and renew this flourishing age; let hymns of merit echo forever for posterity--this is how we may 'feast with august Heaven and enrich generations to come.'
translations.idiomatic: Order the ministry to restore ya orchestra and nine-fold 《Shao》, tying glory to heaven so merit songs endure—fulfilling the ode's pledge to feast heaven and bless heirs.

sentences.zh: 諸伎而傷人者，皆宜除之。

translations.literal: Every novelty that maims performers ought to be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Ban every stunt that breaks human bodies.

sentences.zh: 流簡儉之德，邁康哉之詠，清風既行，下應如草，此之謂也。

translations.literal: Diffuse the virtue of thrift and plainness, rise to the anthem of peaceful praise; once the pure wind blows, the realm bends like grass--that is what I mean.
translations.idiomatic: Spread austere simplicity and the praise “How vast!”; when purity moves, the people bow like grass.

sentences.zh: 愚管之誠，惟垂采察！

translations.literal: This foolish tube offers its sincerity--may Your Majesty bend to examine it!"
translations.idiomatic: My humble pipe speaks plainly—may the throne deign to read it."

sentences.zh: 」於是除《高絙》、《紫鹿》、《跂行》、《鱉食》及《齊王卷衣》、《笮兒》等樂，又減其廩。

translations.literal: Thereupon they removed 《High Tightrope》, 《Purple Deer》, 《Heel-Walking》, 《Turtle-Feeding》, plus 《Prince of Qi Rolls His Coat》, 《Zuo Youth》, and similar acts, and also cut their grain allowances.
translations.idiomatic: The court then banned rope-walking, deer dances, stilt gaits, turtle tricks, the Qi prince skit, and the bamboo-boy show, slashing those troupes' rations.

sentences.zh: 其後復《高絙》、《紫鹿》焉。

translations.literal: Later 《High Tightrope》 and 《Purple Deer》 were revived.
translations.idiomatic: Eventually the rope act and purple deer dance returned.
